# A slot's component-typed invocation entry, populated by name at the
# insertion, run on the interpreter. It mounts slot content in place rather
# than splicing it, so it answers the question a second time: the content is
# written in `site`'s body and reads `site`'s `pages`, while the population
# around it is written in `probe`'s and reads the insertion's `fm`. The entry is
# inserted inside `frame`'s population, which is where a layout puts its content.
#
# The snapshot golden is the claim. The first page carries its content, the
# second its entry's fallback, and neither the insertion's fallback.
#
# testdata/slot_invocation_component.txtar is the same program for the targets
# that splice it; this is the one that has to run.

sngl test --platform none site.sngl
stdout 'ok'

-- site.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

struct Frontmatter {
    title string = ""
}

component frame(main component node) node {
    vbox {
        main
    }
}

component site(layout component(fm Frontmatter, content component node) node) node {
    var pages = 2

    vbox {
        layout(Frontmatter{title="One"}) {
            component content {
                text(value="first of {pages} pages")
            }
        }
        layout(Frontmatter{title="Two"}) {
            text(value="fallback for an unpopulated layout")
        }
    }
}

component probe node {
    site {
        component layout(fm, body) {
            vbox {
                text(value=fm.title)
                frame {
                    component main {
                        body {
                            text(value="no content supplied")
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

func testContentReachesTheLayout(t Test, c probe) {
    t.snapshot("tree")
}

window {
    probe
}
-- site.sngl.snapshots/tree.sngl --
vbox() {
    vbox() {
        text(value="One")
        vbox() {
            text(value="first of 2 pages")
        }
    }
    vbox() {
        text(value="Two")
        vbox() {
            text(value="no content supplied")
        }
    }
}
